fullPassage: Anger is clearly related to aggression but they are not one and the same. It is possible to be aggressive without being angry, and it is equally possible to be angry without becoming aggressive. However, the two (the emotion of anger and the behaviour of aggression) are linked and are biologically based, with obvious survival value. Anger always results in a much increased burst of energy and, although biologically based, is seen by some psychologists as largely socially constructed. That is, some people might be temperamentally more prone to anger than others, but the extent to which they express this is probably socially determined. In our culture, for example, boys are encouraged to express their anger more openly than girls and a far greater proportion of men than women are made to take anger management courses. These are learned differences, not differences of biology.

questions.passage: Anger is clearly related to aggression but they are not one and the same. It is possible to be aggressive without being angry, and it is equally possible to be angry without becoming aggressive. However, the two (the emotion of anger and the behaviour of aggression) are linked and are biologically based, with obvious survival value. Anger always results in a much increased burst of energy and, although biologically based, is seen by some psychologists as largely socially constructed. That is, some people might be temperamentally more prone to anger than others, but the extent to which they express this is probably socially determined. In our culture, for example, boys are encouraged to express their anger more openly than girls and a far greater proportion of men than women are made to take anger management courses. These are learned differences, not differences of biology.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 아래 조건에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
우리말: 그들이 그것을 표현하는 정도는 아마도 사회적으로 결정된다
[조건] (1) determined, express, extent, is, probably, socially, the, they, this, to, which를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 11단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: the extent(그 정도) to which they express this(그들이 그것을 표현하는) is probably socially determined(아마도 사회적으로 결정된다)
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- 주어: the extent to which they express this (그들이 그것을 표현하는 정도)
- 'to which'는 전치사+관계대명사로 the extent를 수식
- 동사: is (단수 주어 the extent에 수일치)
- 보어: probably socially determined (아마도 사회적으로 결정되는)
det.tip: the extent to which S+V = ~가 …하는 정도. 전치사+관계대명사(to which).
